items.contentSnippet:

I've been working on a way to visualize customer feedback/messages from e-mail, chat, reviews, etc over time.
Clustering it into modules AND submodules is really handy, so that is what I made.
For example, you for a accounting app it would be something like:
Module: invoice
Sub-modules: create invoice, send invoice, delete invoice, add lines, etc
This really helps showing what is going on, the good, the bad and the ...you know.
